# THE OWED LEDGER of the name-buildability nightly (tools/namebuild/owed.go).
# One line per (leg, row) that does not build yet, with its true cause:
#   <leg> <row> owed: <cause>
# An exact set: a failure not listed here fails the nightly, and a listed job
# that builds fails it too (stale), so each line goes when its fix lands.
# Found by the generator-internal-name sweep (#4947).

# C: the C backend's own refusal is not lifted to the checker
c n_internal_52 owed: enum placed beside enum placed_t: the C backend qualifies both to probe_placed_t and refuses at generate; schema check accepts the pair

# C++ table: a local of the load code hides a lowercase enum, and the reset spells the enum bare (`E()`)
cpp n_internal_12 owed: enum body_len: cpptable's local body_len hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = body_len();`
cpp n_internal_17 owed: enum count: cpptable's local count hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = count();`
cpp n_internal_18 owed: enum counted_ok: cpptable's local counted_ok hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = counted_ok();`
cpp n_internal_20 owed: enum decoded: cpptable's local decoded hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = decoded();`
cpp n_internal_27 owed: enum field_ref: cpptable's local field_ref hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = field_ref();`
cpp n_internal_32 owed: enum ids: cpptable's parameter `TableIds & ids` hides it in TableEnumRef( TableIds & ids, ids value, ... ) and `case ids::None`
cpp n_internal_33 owed: union arm int32_t: the packet union member is written `Inner ::int32_t;`, which C++ reads as a qualified name; schema check accepts an arm named like a <cstdint> type
cpp n_internal_36 owed: enum keep: cpptable's local keep hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = keep();`
cpp n_internal_47 owed: enum nodes: cpptable's parameter nodes (TableNodeMap) hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = nodes();`
cpp n_internal_51 owed: enum path: cpptable's parameter path (TableRetainPath) hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = path();`
cpp n_internal_53 owed: enum previous_count: cpptable's local previous_count hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = previous_count();`
cpp n_internal_54 owed: enum r: cpptable's parameter r (TableReader) hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = r();`
cpp n_internal_62 owed: enum retain: cpptable's parameter retain hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = retain();`
cpp n_internal_66 owed: enum serialize_fixed: a function-like macro of the serialize runtime, so `serialize_fixed()` expands as the macro; schema check does not claim the runtime's macro names
cpp n_internal_70 owed: enum sub: cpptable's local sub (TableReader) hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = sub();`
cpp n_internal_71 owed: enum tail: cpptable's loop variable tail hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = tail();`
cpp n_internal_75 owed: enum v: cpptable's local v (a lambda) hides it in `v()` and `v + ...`
cpp n_internal_76 owed: enum value: cpptable's parameter value hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = value();`
cpp n_internal_80 owed: enum write_float: a function-like macro of the serialize runtime, so `write_float()` expands as the macro; schema check does not claim the runtime's macro names
cpp n_internal_82 owed: enum body_end: cpptable's local body_end hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = body_end();`
cpp n_internal_83 owed: enums elem_kind and field_id: cpptable's locals of those names hide them in `value.manyN[tail] = E();`
cpp n_internal_88 owed: enums write_int and write_string: function-like macros of the serialize runtime expand in `E()`; schema check does not claim the runtime's macro names
cpp n_internal_91 owed: enum kind: cpptable's local kind hides it in `value.manyN[tail] = kind();`

# C#: a contextual keyword the reserved-word table lacks
cs n_internal_75 owed: enum unmanaged: the generic constraint `where T : unmanaged` resolves to the enum, CS0701; schema check does not reserve unmanaged for C#
unity n_internal_75 owed: enum unmanaged: the generic constraint `where T : unmanaged` resolves to the enum, CS0701; schema check does not reserve unmanaged for C#

# Elixir: a lowercase declaration's module name is another module's
elixir n_internal_49 owed: enum other: Elixir names it Probe.Other, the module of Other.schema, so Probe.Other.write_holder!/1 is lost

# Goose: the view library's private names are not lifted to the checker
goose n_internal_21 owed: enum dst: ProbeView declares _dstViewVariants, which ProbeTable already declares; goose refuses at generate, schema check accepts
goose n_internal_32 owed: enum image: ProbeView declares _imageViewVariants, which ProbeTable already declares; goose refuses at generate, schema check accepts
goose n_internal_44 owed: enum myLayout: ProbeView declares _myLayoutViewVariants, which ProbeTable already declares; goose refuses at generate, schema check accepts
goose n_internal_68 owed: enum source: ProbeView declares _sourceViewVariants, which ProbeTable already declares; goose refuses at generate, schema check accepts

# Lobster: a builtin the reserved-word table lacks
lobster n_internal_33 owed: enum infinity: Lobster reads infinity as its float constant, not an identifier; schema check does not reserve it for Lobster

# Rust: an enum is a tuple struct, and no let, parameter, for or match binding may shadow a tuple struct (E0530)
rust n_internal_14 owed: enums c, c0, c1, c2: generated let bindings of those names cannot shadow the tuple structs
rust n_internal_21 owed: enum e: a generated function parameter e cannot shadow the tuple struct
rust n_internal_26 owed: enums f, f0, f1: generated let bindings and parameters of those names cannot shadow the tuple structs
rust n_internal_32 owed: enum i: a generated for binding i cannot shadow the tuple struct
rust n_internal_58 owed: enum raw_value: a generated let binding raw_value cannot shadow the tuple struct
rust n_internal_75 owed: enums v0, v1: generated let bindings of those names cannot shadow the tuple structs
rust n_internal_76 owed: enum value: a generated function parameter value cannot shadow the tuple struct
rust n_internal_83 owed: enum float_value: a generated let binding float_value cannot shadow the tuple struct
rust n_internal_91 owed: enum arm: a generated match binding arm cannot shadow the tuple struct
# Rust: module and derived-name clashes, and an edition keyword
rust n_internal_19 owed: enums days and daysFrom: both derive days_from_json_name (E0428); schema check does not see derived names
rust n_internal_43 owed: enums mismatch and mismatchFrom: both derive mismatch_from_json_name (E0428); schema check does not see derived names
rust n_internal_30 owed: enum gen: a reserved keyword in Rust 2024; schema check does not reserve gen for Rust
rust n_internal_49 owed: enum other: the crate's module other (Other.schema) and the enum other are one name (E0255)
rust n_internal_53 owed: enum probe: the crate's module probe (Probe.schema) and the enum probe are one name (E0255)
rust n_internal_71 owed: enum tables: the crate's module tables (the table runtime) and the enum tables are one name (E0255)
